text.en: A knight rides out at break of day, and somehow takes the map away.
text.zh-CN: 骑士清早出了门，顺手把地图也带走了。

text.en: That explains why everyone's asking for directions.
A little. Are you waiting for someone?
Looking for him, actually. He has a talent for finding trouble before breakfast.
text.zh-CN: 其实是在找人。他总能在早饭前就找到麻烦。

text.en: Then travel with us. We seem to have a talent for finding it afterward.
text.zh-CN: 那就和我们同行吧。我们通常在早饭后找到麻烦。

text.en: Your good reputation got here before you did. I'd be glad to travel together.
text.zh-CN: 你的好名声，比你先到了这里。我很乐意与你同行。

text.en: Not yet. A good reputation matters when you're trusting someone with your life.
text.zh-CN: 暂时还不行。把性命托付给别人时，好名声很重要。
